voyage.name: Amathus
voyage.content: Ancient royal city.

voyage.name: Kourion
voyage.content: Archaeological site that includes a well-preserved Greco-Roman theatre and other sites of historic importance, namely The House of Achilles, The Altar of Apollo and spectacular views of the Curium Beach.

voyage.name: Kolossi Castle
voyage.content: Former crusader stronghold

voyage.name: St. Catherine's Church
voyage.content: Roman Catholic Church completed in 1879.

voyage.name: Governor's Beach
voyage.content: Long, sandy beach with many beach-side fish restaurants, and a beautiful white stone coast to the west.

voyage.name: Lady's Mile Beach
voyage.content: Long mostly-pebbly, partly sandy beach with several beach-side fish restaurants. Try watching birds at the salt lake nearby. There is a UK military air base in the area.

voyage.name: Hfwlia Tou Koukou
voyage.content: Greek

voyage.name: Monastiraki Athens
voyage.content: Greek

voyage.name: Rio Bravo Saloon
voyage.content: Tex Mex

voyage.name: Kyrenia Fish Tavern
voyage.content: Beach-side tavern in Yermasoyia tourist area (opposite Mirage traffic lights). Traditional Cypriot fish meze for €21.

voyage.name: Ocean Basket Germasogeia
voyage.content: Fish restaurant. Another branch in the western part of the city at My Mall.

voyage.name: Syrian restaurant
voyage.content: Lebanese-style tavern/restaurant with excellent meze in Yermasoyia tourist area.

voyage.name: Draught Microbrewery
voyage.content: Restaurant and bar in the Carob Mill next to the Limassol Castle. Specializes in grills.

voyage.name: Agios Georgios Alamanou Restaurant
voyage.address: Pentakomo Exit from A1 Highway, Monagroulli
voyage.content: Seafood restaurant outside Limassol situated on a white-stoned beach.

voyage.name: The Steak House
voyage.address: Limassol old port, building S Limassol

voyage.name: GSpot Beach Cafe
voyage.content: A laid-back beachfront cafe on the coastal road near Limassol Zoo. Frequented by locals, a popular place to pick up a coffee or smoothie and sit on the provided beach chairs.

voyage.name: Chesters
voyage.content: Irish-style bar in tourist area opposite St. Raphel hotel. Good selection of beers and food.

voyage.name: Salut Bar & Restaurant
voyage.content: Trendy venue combining bar and restaurant, with creative cocktails, brunch, Mediterranean and Lebanese dishes, and live music.

voyage.name: Draught Microbrewery
voyage.content: Restaurant and bar in the Carob Mill next to the Limassol Castle. Has its own small beer brewery.

voyage.name: Molly Malones
voyage.content: Irish-style bar in tourist area opposite Elias Beach hotel. Good selection of beers and food. Closed for the foreseeable future due to the gutting of its building.

voyage.name: 7Seas
voyage.content: In Old Town. Probably the classiest live music nightclub in the town.

voyage.name: Dolce
voyage.content: Next to Amathus excavation. Nightclub which often has live music and international DJs.

voyage.name: L'Onda
voyage.content: The forerunner of a new wave of boutique hotels. Pricy but classy. Highly rated and expensive restaurant, with a good selection of local wines. Popular with locals and tourists alike.

voyage.name: Parklane Resort & Spa
voyage.content: Considered as one of the best hotels on the island but you pay for what you get.

voyage.name: Amathus Beach Hotel
voyage.content: Member of The Leading Hotels of the World. A five-star hotel that does not belong to a globalized conglomerate but non the less, a worthy rival.

voyage.name: Four Seasons
voyage.content: A 5-star hotel. Getting a room facing the road can mean noisy nights, as this becomes a race track for locals after 22:00. Not affiliated with the global Four Seasons chain.
